relations.evidence: Geshe Wangyal, my guru and kalyanamitra, has en- couraged and inspired all of my studies over the past ten years.

relations.evidence: The late Prof. Richard Robinson gave me great practical help and advice during my first year of graduate study; his intellectual breadth and rigor provided a worthy model to all who studied with him.
